result.reason: The operative language covers Customer, Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer’s behalf; makes paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable; limits subscription termination through Section 13.3 to an uncured material payment or use breach after notice and cure opportunity; and permits transfer to successors under Section 24. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing paid-up licence and assignment framework. Drafting is professional, though Section 13.1’s use of “terminable” cross-refers to Section 13.3’s “revoke or suspend” terminology rather than expressly addressing termination.
